brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is framing an attack on a Flydubai aircraft within his campaign messaging about threats to Israelis ahead of voting, Al Jazeera English reported. The motive behind the incident remains unclear, but Netanyahu has seized on the event to amplify his warnings of security dangers facing the country.

The timing allows Netanyahu to return attention to security concerns as a central election issue, a traditional strength for his political positioning ahead of the vote.
dek: Motive behind Flydubai incident still unclear, but Israeli PM is framing it within his warnings of threats to Israelis.
title: Netanyahu uses Flydubai incident to reinforce election security warnings
